recognitionRules: Use a persistent spine, footer rule and return-to-menu tab.
Pair Avenir instructions with selective Chalkboard annotations.
Use green, cream and gold as the stable frame, with rust for focused cues.
Keep menu bands labeled with activity and planned duration.
Retain evidence IDs when moving from records to proposed tests.

writingLinks.name: Spoken invitation
writingLinks.reason: Spoken facilitation with timed notes, preserved dissent and an equivalent written path.

quote: Start with the evidence. Return to the question. Choose a next test together.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use FIELDNOTES WORKSHOP in Avenir with a narrow vertical spine and a small workshop code. No compass or notebook icon.
invariants: Use a persistent spine, footer rule and return-to-menu tab.
Pair Avenir instructions with selective Chalkboard annotations.
Use green, cream and gold as the stable frame, with rust for focused cues.
adaptations: Short workshops can reduce menu items while keeping return navigation.
Print editions replace clickable tabs with page references.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
